notes.title: Score system and leaderboard
notes.content:
I added the score system and steam global leaderboards, with other achievements associated with the scores.

how it works basically:
-for every topulus you kill the multiplier increases by 1 and the score increases multiplied
-if you get hit you lose the multiplied points and the multiplier returns to 1
-if you take any medikits you lose 1000 points and the multiplier returns to 1
-if you destroy the paintings or minitopulus your points are subtracted and the multiplier returns to 1.

proves to be the Master of Topulus and have fun!
Edd
